limitations: Real live catalog: needs an access_token from a session started on a real device with the Play-installed app (Play Integrity). With that token, the operational script downloads and decrypts the full catalog without further changes.
Real file exported by the app (an eut:// / eut-settings:// / eut-payload:// generated by the app, or a text file imported by it) to confirm the format end to end.
Real cloud code (payload-share/get) to verify the code download with a real token.
Local SQLCipher database: open it with sqlcipher (not stdlib) and confirm the stored data matches the server data.
Re-verify when the app version rises (import rejects app_version_code > 370 and the server may change the catalog).
network_requirements: Live catalog verification needs network access to the vendor's catalog host (exact request lives in the operational script; no download endpoint is reproduced in this dossier). All dossier tests run offline.

connection_authentication.note: No HMAC was observed in the sza envelope (AES-CBC, no MAC) or in the eut-payload:// v1 envelope (AES-GCM tag, AEAD — not an HMAC). Connection authentication here is Play Integrity attestation + a Bearer session token verified server-side by Google/the vendor; the token exchange was observed only as blocking responses (400/401/403), never as a successful attestation, so connection authentication stays UNCONFIRMED. VPN transport authentication was not researched.
connection_authentication.rule: The mere presence of an HMAC library or a Mac.init call confirms nothing. No key values and no hook inputs/outputs are stored in this dossier.
